title: Bridge module purpose
description: Module-level documentation explaining the bridge's role and design.
body: `@openkaava/bridge` is what a tool's `ui/` imports instead of `@tauri-apps/api`. Same tool code runs either host: an iframe under the orchestrator shell, or a top-level window in its own standalone Tauri app. Wires `createClient` (the testable core) to the real `window`. A singleton, not a factory: a frontend has one host for its lifetime, decided once at load.
